title: eval-harness: add per-prompt CI hook + quality gating and metrics integration
author: Aisha Khan
description: Summary: Add a per-prompt CI hook to the eval-harness that runs lightweight per-prompt regression checks on PRs, wires results into our metrics pipeline, and enforces configurable quality gates. Motivation: recent multi-prompt regressions were missed by coarse-grained CI; this change provides deterministic per-prompt checks with sensible defaults to catch regressions early while capping CI cost. What this PR does: adds a GitHub Actions workflow (ci/workflows/eval-harness-per-prompt.yml) that executes a sample-based per-prompt runner, introduces a small per_prompt_runner service and a wrapper script that can be invoked from CI, integrates results with the existing metrics exporter (prometheus + internal metrics pipeline), and updates docs and config to opt-in the hook via .github/eval-config.yaml. Design notes: hook is opt-in by default to limit blast radius; default thresholds and sample sizes are tuned for quick feedback (~3-5 minutes on CI) and can be overridden per-repo. Includes a Linear design reference (ENG-8421) and follow-up task for improving threshold tuning (ENG-8466). Checklist: - [x] design + Linear link ENG-8421 - [x] unit tests for runner - [x] CI workflow and smoke runs - [x] metrics export integration - [x] docs and quickstart snippet. Risk/backwards-compatibility: opt-in and runtime limits minimize risk; no breaking API changes. See commits summary, files changed, CI results, and reviewer conversation below for details.

review_comments: Jordan Kim (reviewer): Can we add a dry-run mode that writes the computed deltas to CI artifacts without failing? This would help on-boarding.

Priya Desai (reviewer): Thresholds look aggressive for some small prompts; suggest exposing per-prompt override in eval-config and adding a conservative default.
Author (Aisha Khan): Exposed overrides in .github/eval-config.yaml and adjusted defaults to be less aggressive; added test case for override behavior.
Tomislav Horvat (approver): LGTM after minor nit on logging verbosity; please squash the logging cleanup into the runner commit before merge.
release_notes: Adds opt-in per-prompt CI hook for eval-harness with configurable quality gates and metrics integration. This enables earlier detection of prompt-level regressions in PRs.
